title: The Tide of Port Alder
author: Beatrix Fairweather
blurb: Silas Dunmore, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
